originalTitle: Landon Barker - If I Ever Talk To God (Official Music Video)
content: Listen to "If I Ever Talk To God" here: https://ffm.to/ifievertalktogod Follow Landon Barker TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@landonbarkerr Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/landonbarker Shop - https://landonbarkermerch.com/ Lyrics: Ooh if I ever talk to God I talk about you In the night I close my eyes I dream about you Every song I try to write I write about you It ain’t much to tell you slow down Just some messed up kids with some messed up friends Inside an old town I could see myself in a picture frame but I’m alone now When I called you up couldn’t talk enough Or put the phone down Oh baby you should know now oh Mixing you with alcohol Talking but we said it all Promise that we meet again Wonder if this ever ends Ooh if I ever talk to God I talk about you In the night I close my eyes I dream about you Every song I try to write I write about you I could make the whole world stop right now But at least I tried dawg This bottle won’t drink itself So I’ll just high, doll I can’t seem to reason without you So I talk to people about you And they tell me I’m bad at leaving I think I’m done for the season Mixing you with alcohol Talking but we said it all Promise that we meet again Wonder if this ever ends Ooh if I ever talk to God I talk about you In the night I close my eyes I dream about you Every song I try to write I write about you And we’ll talk in the middle of the night Whenever you call Whatever I said Whenever I went wrong And we’ll talk yeah whenever you’re back I would take it all back Miss the way that you laugh Hate the way that we left off Video Credits: ARTIST Artist: Landon Barker feat.
